title: UAP fly around government teams at events while the teams do not notice

tellings.quote: We are arriving in the first day, and around their west fly NAYA, and They have no idea.

plain: At government test events sometime between 2021 and 2025, unidentified flying objects, which the government calls UAP (unidentified anomalous phenomena), flew around the government's own teams without those teams noticing, says James Valor of Skywatcher, a startup that tries to summon UFOs. Valor tells it as someone who was there, saying that on the first day the objects flew around the teams and "they have no idea," which would mean the official watchers were missing what was right in front of them.
